snippet.title: 2 birds 1 stone - Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Shoot birds. Get paid. Shoot more birds. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5498600/2_birds_1_stone/

2 Birds 1 Stone is a bird-hunting clicker, idler, and incremental game with a healthy dose of NES-era duck hunting nostalgia.

Click to shoot, sell your haul, then spend the money in the Hunting Shop. Features a massive upgrade tree, tons of unique weapons, and dozens of bird species keep the hunt going. Hired hunters with ever sillier weapons take the work off your hands so you can kick back and enjoy the show.

- Hunting Season: a roguelike card draw at the start of every hunt builds your crew
- Process, refine, and package your haul to multiply its value
- Chase golden birds for jackpots
- Play with just a mouse
- 23 Steam achievements and Steam Cloud saves

On Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Website: https://yamagames.com/games/2-birds-1-stone/
Press kit: https://yamagames.com/games/2-birds-1-stone/press/

Made by Yama Games, LLC. https://yamagames.com
